# Kenney Nature Kit

This directory contains the complete set of 329 GLB models from Kenney's
Nature Kit 2.1. The collection is kept intact so Dross and ThumpDemo can use it
as a recognizable prototyping kit rather than as an untraceable assortment of
models.

## Imported files

`models/` contains every model from the archive's `Models/GLTF format/`
directory. GLB is directly importable by Godot and embeds this kit's material
data, so no separate textures are required.

The current collection page describes 330 files, while the downloaded archive
contains 329 models in each model format. This directory accurately preserves
all 329 GLB models present in that archive.

The archive's duplicate DAE, FBX, OBJ/MTL, and STL models, rendered PNG
previews, URL shortcuts, and promotional material are intentionally omitted.
They are not runtime dependencies of the GLB models.
